headline.zh: 为 AI 代理选择计算环境
headline.en: Choose Compute Environment for AI Agents

scenario.zh: 展示如何根据代理任务特点选择操作系统和资源配置,使用虚构场景演示环境配置决策
scenario.en: Demonstrate how to select operating system and resource configuration based on agent task characteristics using fictional scenarios

instruction.zh: 根据代理工具需求选择环境
instruction.en: Choose environment based on agent tool requirements

output.zh: 适合脚本和容器化工具
output.en: Suitable for scripts and containerized tools

input.zh: 代理需要运行 Python 数据处理脚本,使用开源分析库,处理表格数据文件
input.en: Agent needs to run Python data processing scripts, use open-source analysis libraries, handle tabular data files

output.zh: Ubuntu 系统,Python 运行时,常用科学计算库可用,独立文件空间
output.en: Ubuntu system, Python runtime, common scientific libraries available, isolated file space

output.zh: 支持 Windows 专用工具

input.zh: 代理需要调用 PowerShell 脚本管理文档,使用 Windows 自动化工具处理办公文件
input.en: Agent needs to invoke PowerShell scripts to manage documents, use Windows automation tools to process office files

output.zh: Windows Server 系统,PowerShell 环境,自动化框架就绪,受控文件访问
output.en: Windows Server system, PowerShell environment, automation framework ready, controlled file access

output.zh: 适合 Apple 生态工具

input.zh: 代理需要测试 iOS 应用构建流程,运行 Xcode 命令行工具,验证应用签名
input.en: Agent needs to test iOS app build process, run Xcode command-line tools, verify app signatures

output.zh: macOS 系统,Xcode 工具链,模拟器支持,隔离开发环境
output.en: macOS system, Xcode toolchain, simulator support, isolated development environment

instruction.zh: 根据任务负载选择资源层级
instruction.en: Select resource tier based on task workload

output.zh: 适合简单脚本和短任务
output.en: Suitable for simple scripts and short tasks

input.zh: 每小时运行一次,执行时间约五分钟,处理小型文本文件
input.en: Runs once per hour, execution time around five minutes, processes small text files

output.zh: 双核处理器,四GB 内存,十GB 临时存储,按使用时长计费
output.en: Dual-core processor, four GB memory, ten GB temporary storage, billed by usage duration

input.zh: 持续运行,中等计算密集度,需要处理多个并发请求
input.en: Continuous operation, moderate compute intensity, needs to handle multiple concurrent requests

output.zh: 四核处理器,八GB 内存,五十GB 临时存储,支持自动扩展
output.en: Quad-core processor, eight GB memory, fifty GB temporary storage, supports auto-scaling

input.zh: 大规模数据处理,复杂模型训练,需要较长执行时间
input.en: Large-scale data processing, complex model training, requires extended execution time

output.zh: 八核处理器,三十二GB 内存,两百GB 临时存储,优先级调度
output.en: Octa-core processor, thirty-two GB memory, two hundred GB temporary storage, priority scheduling

takeaway.zh: 演示了根据代理工具和负载特征选择计算环境的虚构配置示例。实际环境需通过 Daytona API 创建,资源会根据需求弹性伸缩
takeaway.en: Illustrated fictional configuration examples for selecting compute environments based on agent tools and workload characteristics. Actual environments must be created through Daytona API with elastic resource scaling
